name: Supanote
description: Supanote is an AI scribe purpose-built for mental health professionals with 10+ note formats, 20+ therapy modalities, and 120+ languages. Pricing: Free (5 notes/month), Starter $29.99/mo (40 notes), Professional $39.99/mo (100 notes), Premium $69.99/mo (unlimited), XL $89.99/mo (unlimited + group sessions). Key differentiator: 'Super Fill' one-click feature pushes completed notes directly into SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Valant, Tebra, and ICANotes—eliminating copy-paste. AI personalization engine learns each therapist's documentation style over time. HIPAA and PHIPA compliant. Priced higher than AutoNotes ($34/mo) and Mentalyc Pro ($69.99/mo) at the unlimited tier, but Super Fill EHR integration may justify premium for high-volume therapists.

faqs.q: How much does Supanote cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Supanote offers Free (5 notes/mo), Starter $29.99/mo (40 notes), Professional $39.99/mo (100 notes), Premium $69.99/mo (unlimited), and XL $89.99/mo (unlimited + group sessions). Annual billing discounts available.

faqs.q: What is Supanote's Super Fill feature?
faqs.a: Super Fill is one-click integration that pushes completed notes directly into SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Valant, Tebra, and ICANotes—eliminating copy-paste. This is Supanote's key differentiator vs competitors.

Supanote is therapy-focused. Psychiatrists needing medication management, prescribing documentation, and MSE should use Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub (contact for pricing). Supanote excels for therapy sessions, not psychiatric med checks.

faqs.q: Supanote vs Mentalyc: which is better for therapists?
faqs.a: Mentalyc Pro ($69.99/mo unlimited) is cheaper than Supanote XL ($89.99/mo). Supanote's advantage is Super Fill EHR integration with SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and Valant. If you use those EHRs and want one-click export, Supanote. For pure note quality at lower cost, Mentalyc.

faqs.q: Does Supanote support group therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, on the XL plan ($89.99/mo). Lower tiers support individual sessions only. Group session documentation includes multi-participant notes and group therapy formats.
